targets.summary: The C++ standard version stated in RELEASE.md looks wrong or out of date, since PyTorch has at least partly moved to C++20, so the text should be corrected.
targets.evidence: The maintainer asked why the 2.13 row said C++17 when PyTorch has moved to C++20, at least partly. Before: `| 2.13 | >=3.10, <=(3.15, 3.15t experimental) | C++17 | CUDA 12.6 ... | ROCm 7.2 |`. Merged: `| 2.13 | >=3.10, <=(3.15, 3.15t experimental) | C++20 | CUDA 12.6 ... | ROCm 7.2 |`. The commented line's C++ column went from C++17 to C++20, which fixes the outdated version. The merged text does not add a "partial" note, but it settles the maintainer's main point.
